content.short: Benji Bananas is a mobile game using Web3 and crypto, featuring the PRIMATE token and a Benji Bananas Membership Pass NFT for play-to-earn.
content.description: Benji Bananas is a popular mobile game with over 50 million downloads. It introduces the PRIMATE token, which lets players earn tokens through in-game play. Access to the play-to-earn system is gated by owning a Benji Bananas Membership Pass NFT, which players must obtain to participate. This integration combines casual gameplay with crypto rewards, allowing players to earn while they play and advance within the Benji Bananas ecosystem.
